mentions.name: eincalc
mentions.description: A spreadsheet app being built to leverage the upcoming WebNN browser spec, integrating vision, audio, and language models to extend spreadsheets beyond their traditional focus on numerical data.
mentions.problem: Traditional spreadsheet apps lean mainly towards numerical data, limiting the possibilities of what spreadsheets can do.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm looking to leverage the upcoming WebNN browser spec with my spreadsheet app. I think integration with vision, audio and language models opens a whole new world of possibilities as traditional spreadsheet apps lean more towards mainly numerical data.

https://harryk.dev/apps/eincalc
